description: Calculate EU261/UK261 compensation for a disrupted flight. Use this when you need to determine the compensation amount for a specific flight disruption. Do NOT use for general compensation rules; use disruption_rights instead.

arrival.description: Arrival airport IATA code, e.g. JFK

arrival_delay_hours.description: Arrival delay in hours, as a number

departure.description: Departure airport IATA code, e.g. LHR

disrupted.description: Flight identifier for the disrupted flight

distance_km.description: Flight distance in kilometers, as a number

notice_days.description: Number of days notice given for the disruption

reason_category.description: Category of disruption reason, e.g. technical, weather

reroute_arrival_delay_hours.description: Arrival delay in hours for the rerouted flight, as a number

rerouted.description: True if the flight was rerouted, false otherwise

name: check_compensation

compensation_amount.description: The amount of compensation in EUR, if eligible.

compensation_currency.description: The currency of the compensation amount.

distance_km.description: The distance between the departure and arrival airports in kilometers.

eligible.description: Indicates whether the passenger is eligible for compensation.

reason.description: The reason for the compensation amount or ineligibility.

title: Check compensation
